newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am revives Carnival deal talks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am revives Carnival deal talks - paper.

text.p: Pan American World Airways, a unit of Pan Am Corp, is in talks to acquire a leading regional rival, Carnival Air Lines, the Miami Herald newspaper said on Wednesday.
Last July, Pan Am agreed to pay about $100 million for Carnival Air but the transaction was called off after Pan Am examined the carrier's books and sought to rework terms.
Spokesmen for Pan Am and privately held Carnival Air, both of which specialize in the south Florida market, were not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
Carnival, with 15 jets to Pan Am's four, is majority owned by Mickey Ariston, chief executive of leading cruise-ship operator Carnival Corp.
